package.description: Convert repositories into single, portable structure-preserving documents.

en-US.description: Convert repositories into single, portable structure-preserving documents.
en-US.longDescription: repo2page is a developer tool that converts an entire GitHub or local repository into a single, portable, structure-preserving document. It supports Markdown, HTML, and Plain Text output formats, respects .gitignore, and is distributed as a single binary with zero runtime dependencies.
en-US.name: repo2page
